howToApply: Visit the TGPSC official website at https://www.tgpsc.gov.in.
If not already registered, complete the One Time Registration (OTR) to obtain a TGPSC ID.
Login using your TGPSC ID and Date of Birth, then authenticate via OTP received on your registered mobile number.
Verify the details fetched from the OTR database (Name, Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, Community, Gender, Disability, Ex-Servicemen & Sports, etc.).
Select the preferred examination centre.
Preview the application for correctness and click on SAVE & PAYMENT button.
Pay the prescribed application processing fee and examination fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
After payment, download the generated PDF application form and note the Reference ID Number for future reference.
